content: CUDA EP common issues: DLL crashes with TLS callback init (Windows), undefined symbol errors for NVRTC (Linux/NixOS), CUDA provider not enabled in build errors, no CUDA-capable device detected in containers, missing CUDA implementations for certain ops at optimization levels, provider switching causes errors without cache dir in options. Always include CPU fallback in provider list. Version matrix between CUDA/cuDNN/driver/ORT must be exact.
